entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A tracker, hunter and protector who lives in the Ulvenwald with Alena and guards Kessig from werewolves.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A skilled tracker and Halana's partner who protects the Ulvenwald and has a sharp sense of scent.

entities.name: Mrs. Palter
entities.description: A cursed woman possessed by the demon Ormendahl through a contract, who kills Elder Somlon, the bell-ringer, Lady Evelin and her own husband.

entities.name: Cathar Palter
entities.description: A kindly cathar of the Lunarch Council and former mausoleum guard from Gavony, who hides his wife's crimes and is stabbed by her.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf who leads a pack, can change form in battle, saves Halana and Alena from Mrs. Palter, and warns them to leave the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Farmer Warin
entities.description: A farmer who blames Lady Evelin's wards when his cattle are devoured.

entities.name: Wife Warin
entities.description: Warin's wife who reports the possessed cow and accuses Lady Evelin.

entities.name: Elder Kolman
entities.description: A town Elder who presides over the council.

entities.name: Elder Glather
entities.description: An Elder of the Gatstaf council.

entities.name: Elder Somlon
entities.description: An Elder performing death rites for Lady Mary who is killed by Mrs. Palter.

entities.name: Lady Evelin
entities.description: A ward-maker of Gatstaf blamed for failed wards and killed by Mrs. Palter.

entities.name: Innkeeper Shoran
entities.description: An innkeeper who finds blood in the Palters' room.

entities.name: Elsa Shoran
entities.description: The innkeeper's wife who rings the town bell and raises the alarm.

entities.name: Orwell
entities.description: The Gatstaf bell-ringer killed by Mrs. Palter.

entities.name: Lady Mary
entities.description: A woman whose death rites Elder Somlon was performing.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon whose name Mrs. Palter chants and with whom she holds a contract.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose light the townsfolk believe protects them from werewolves.

entities.name: Lycanthropes
entities.description: Werewolves in the Ulvenwald whose resurgence worries Halana and Alena.

entities.name: Arlinn's pack
entities.description: The werewolf pack led by Arlinn that surrounds Halana and Alena.

entities.name: Elders of Gatstaf
entities.description: The council of Elders that governs Gatstaf.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The council to which Cathar Palter belongs.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: A town at the edge of the Ulvenwald in Kessig province.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Innistrad's ancient forest bordering Kessig province and home to lycanthropes.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A province bordered by the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Avabruck
entities.description: The lost capital, a place of geists and werewolf scavengers.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The home of the Palters.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of the Ulvenwald and Gatstaf.

events.summary: At a council meeting in Gatstaf, Farmer Warin and his wife claim a possessed cow ate another and blame Lady Evelin's failed wards.
events.quote: One of our cattle is possessed!

events.summary: Halana and Alena suspect lycanthropes have grown brazen and are working their way to the town after having killed several in the Ulvenwald.
events.quote: they would not let its dark horrors leak out to harm the innocent.

events.summary: The innkeepers burst in claiming Mrs. Palter has been murdered, accusing her husband.
Halana and Alena recall rescuing the Palters in the Ulvenwald and receiving a protective token from the cathar.
events.quote: Hal and Alena had found the cathar and his wife themselves no more than a week ago

events.summary: Halana and Alena slip out and reason that the killer was in a locked room with no forced entry.
events.quote: With no mention of a broken window or forced entry,

events.summary: In the Palters' room they find blood, a torn bit of lace, a silver button and a closet chair with shredded restraints.
events.quote: It was the leather straps and belts that hung from the chair

events.summary: Halana and Alena escape through a window as townsfolk enter the room.
events.quote: Hal and Alena climbed down into the alley without any of the townsfolk being the wiser.

events.summary: Armed with silver, they track Cathar Palter's trail, finding boot prints that become paw prints and a split trail at a crossroads.
events.quote: the next they were tracking the paw prints of a beast

events.summary: Elsa announces the bell-ringer Orwell is dead, and the trackers find the bodies of Orwell, Lady Evelin and Elder Somlon arranged in the woods.
events.quote: the same that had been done to the bell-ringer had been done to the ward-maker, Lady Evelin

events.summary: They realize the lace belongs to Elder Somlon and that the lycanthrope may be Mrs. Palter.
Halana and Alena find Mrs. Palter chanting Ormendahl over her husband on a makeshift altar and tackle her.
events.quote: This woman was in contract with a horror.

events.summary: Alena explains the cathar hid his wife's killings; he begs for her life and blames himself for the mausoleum.
events.quote: Three bodies, Mr. Palter. She killed three innocents.

events.summary: Mrs. Palter breaks free and stabs her husband in the chest, killing him.
events.quote: in one motion tackled and stabbed her husband through the chest.

events.summary: Demonically empowered, Mrs. Palter throws Halana and Alena aside and beats them.
events.quote: called upon the enormous amount of demonic power she had summoned and threw them off her.

events.summary: A lycanthrope strikes Mrs. Palter down, and Halana and Alena stab her dead.
events.quote: Together they plunged their blades into Mrs. Palter's raging, bloody form.

events.summary: A pack of werewolves surrounds them, but the leader changes into a human woman and sends the pack away.
events.quote: Suddenly the beast was a human woman

events.summary: The woman, who says she tracked Mrs. Palter, warns them to stop killing her pack and leave the Ulvenwald, since something worse is coming.
events.quote: I have seen enough, and so have you, to know that whatever is out there is worse than werewolves.

events.summary: The woman resumes wolf form and leaves; Arlinn Kord reflects she cannot have friends.
events.quote: in this life, Arlinn could not have friends.

relations.note: The two trackers live and hunt together.
relations.quote: not when they had each other.

relations.note: Halana and Alena kill werewolves to protect the Ulvenwald.
She commands the pack with a shake of her head.
relations.quote: The woman shook her head once, short and sharp.

relations.note: Arlinn threatens to move against them if they keep killing her pack.
relations.quote: If you do not, I will be forced to move against you.

relations.note: Mrs. Palter stabs her husband through the chest.
relations.quote: in one motion tackled and stabbed her husband through the chest.

relations.note: She chants the demon's name in a contract with it.

relations.quote: stabbed her husband through the chest.
